s.note: the Armitages' guests on the lawn
s.how: Top 16 blinis with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, dill and lemon zest. Cut a cucumber into thick rounds and pipe on 120g goat's cheese whipped with chives. Lay both neatly on silver trays.

s.n: Coloured cereal, milk on the side
s.how: Tip 200g brightly coloured cereal into 4 white bowls and scatter a few raspberries on top. Pour 1L cold milk into 4 tall glasses with a straw each. Serve side by side and eat them separately, a spoon of cereal then a sip of milk.

m.how: Marinate a 1.5kg butterflied lamb leg overnight with 4 garlic cloves, rosemary, lemon and olive oil. Grill over high heat until 55C inside and rest 15 minutes. Chop parsley, capers, garlic and lemon with oil for salsa verde. Slice and spoon over.

w.note: Missy stirring her tea with a silver spoon
w.how: Soak 3 gelatine leaves. Warm 600ml cream with 80g sugar and a split vanilla bean, then stir in the gelatine. Pour into 4 teacups and set 4 hours. Simmer 200g mixed berries with a spoon of sugar and spoon on top. Serve with silver spoons.

d.note: stirred slowly with a silver spoon
d.how: Warm a china teapot with hot water, add 4 tsp black tea and 1L just-boiled water and brew 4 minutes. Pour into teacups with milk and sugar to taste, stirring slowly with a teaspoon so it rings against the cup.
